package.author: Brian Peek
package.description: A simple, portable Win32 text editor in the spirit of classic Windows Notepad.

en-US.author: Brian Peek
en-US.description: A simple, portable Win32 text editor in the spirit of classic Windows Notepad.
en-US.longDescription:
Nanopad is a lightweight Notepad replacement written in pure Win32 C++.
Features include dark/light mode with system theme following, font selection,
Find & Replace, printing, encoding detection (UTF-8, UTF-16, ANSI),
per-monitor DPI scaling, and portable settings via INI file.
Single EXE, no installer, no runtime dependencies.
en-US.name: Nanopad
en-US.releaseNotes:
Nanopad 1.3.3
Fixed
- Tab characters now print as tab stops matching the editor instead of taking up no space.
Download
Extract the zip and run nanopad.exe. Settings are stored in nanopad.ini next to the executable.
────────┬───────────────────────
Platform│Download
────────┼───────────────────────
x64     │Nanopad-1.3.3-x64.zip
────────┼───────────────────────
ARM64   │Nanopad-1.3.3-arm64.zip
────────┴───────────────────────
Install via winget
winget install Ganksoft.Nanopad
